# Procreate

> > Procreate is a suite of creative apps designed for iPad and iPhone, enabling digital artists to sketch, paint, animate, and create with professional-grade tools.

Procreate offers three main creative applications: Procreate (the flagship drawing and illustration app), Procreate Dreams (a 2D animation and video creation tool), and Procreate Pocket (the award-winning iPhone art app). The company is committed to empowering creatives through thoughtfully designed tools that prioritize human creativity over generative AI.
